category_source: Reserved threshold-selection participants, starting waves 1–6, observed valid next-survey outcome; saved stage 8 calibrated predictions
category_rule: First score at which cumulative participant-equal weight reaches 1/3 and 2/3; thresholds use scores/weights only, never outcome optimization. Equal scores stay together. Lower <= cut1; moderate cut1 < p <= cut2; higher p > cut2.
category_caution: Project-defined relative groups in development data; not established medical cutoffs or independently validated risk categories.
incomplete_input_policy: Suppress probability/category/explanation below two supplied model inputs or when cohort eligibility is not confirmed. Otherwise use the actual trained missing handling, retain answer reasons and warn about missingness/distribution shift. This is a project usability guard, not a validated accuracy guarantee.
explanation_method: SHAP ExactExplainer over all four original selected model inputs, independent empirical tuning background; prediction callable is the actual saved calibrated wrapper's positive-class probability. No underlying raw-tree log-odds explanation is substituted.
